name: Banyan Tree Samui
positioning: Pool villa resort on a private hill above its own bay in Lamai, Koh Samui, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand
best_for: Travelers who want a villa with its own pool and a dedicated Villa Host
Snorkellers and paddlers who want a house reef off a private beach
Families using the Kids' Club and Kids' Pool

facts.text: The resort sits on a private hill overlooking Lamai Bay, enveloped by jungle greenery.
A dedicated Villa Host is provided for all villa types.
The Horizon Hillcrest Pool Villa has an extensive outdoor lounge, a sky-suspended swimming pool and open-villa living quarters.
The Royal Banyan Ocean Pool Villa has an infinity pool with an adjacent jet pool.
The Sanctuary Residence has a living area that links two one-bedroom villas.
The Rainforest combines European spa and hydrothermal therapy with Asian wellness in one hydrotherapy experience.
Complimentary beach activities include kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding, sailing and snorkelling in the house reef steps from the shoreline.
The Kids' Club is for children ages four to 12, with activities including arts and crafts and games.
Guests can learn muay thai, or Thai kickboxing, in indoor or outdoor classes.
An on-site Sustainability Manager with a marine biology background works with Thailand's Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to protect the local coral reef.
Saffron serves authentic Thai cuisine with performances of Menora, a traditional dance of southern Thailand.
Destination Dining is set at the main pool with the bay behind it, or at Infinity Point, which looks over the resort.

highlights.text: Banyan Tree Samui overlooks the Gulf of Thailand and sits amid jungle on a private bay in Lamai.
Every villa has a private pool, in a range of configurations, sizes and views.
The Rainforest is a hydrotherapy circuit of heat and cool stages, from sauna to vitality pool.
The resort has a house reef in its bay, reached from its private beach.
Guests can head out on the resort's private speedboat, Sense of the Sea.

considerations.text: The resort is about 5 km from the main area of Lamai and about 15 km from the main area of Chaweng.
The resort says January through October typically bring clear skies, sunny weather and calm seas.
WhataHotel notes the secluded hillside location means navigating steep terrain.
